title: field-lineage
description: The path of one value: where it is born, how it is carried and transformed, where it is stored and who reads it. Stages in order. Not rendered when `stages` is empty.

field.description: The value followed, as code names it (`invoices.total_cents`).

id.description: Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus it.

kind.description: born: where the value first appears; carried: passed on unchanged; transformed: computed or converted; stored: written to a store; read: consumed.

value.description: The value or expression at this stage, as code writes it.

text.description: What happens here, in one sentence.

hot.description: The stage the question is about; drawn on the accent.
